normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Steps from boardwalk beach access- Expansive views of the Gulf from almost every room in the home- Private heated pool **Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $45 per day**- Minutes from Deer Lake State Park- Located in a gated community- Outdoor shower- Free WiFi- 6 adult bikes- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 6 dedicated parking spots- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Nestled within a gated community, Villa Sienna is a stunning coastal home situated along the Emerald Coast in Seagrove Beach. Featuring 6 bedrooms and 5 full bathrooms, this 3,953-square-foot retreat comfortably sleeps 22, making it an excellent choice for large families and groups. Guests will love the enchanting Gulf views from every corner of this house, peaceful afternoons by the private pool, and easy access to white sugar-sand beaches—only a short stroll via the private boardwalk!Step into this thoughtfully designed 3-story home, where the lower-level entrance leads to a multi-generational space boasting wheelchair-accessible doorways, a private bathroom with a zero-step shower, and a first-floor bunk room with 2 twin-over-queen bunks, 1 twin-over-king bunk, and a 32” TV. Outside, unwind under the covered patio, barbecue on the propane grill, or cool off in the private pool. Afterward, rinse off in the outdoor shower and head inside to the convenient in-home elevator for easy access to other floors.The heart of this home resides on the second floor, featuring an open-concept living, kitchen, and dining area, with expansive glass windows and doors illuminating the great room with warm natural light. The living area invites relaxation with plush, white slip-covered furniture facing Gulf views, while the nearby media room is perfect for movie nights or a kid’s hangout spot. The open kitchen boasts high-end appliances, including a Wolf 5-burner cooktop, Sub-Zero fridge, Keurig coffee maker, and touch-sensitive sink—ideal for cooking and entertaining. Gather for gourmet meals around the 12-person dining table, at the 4-seat breakfast bar, or on the second-floor deck for a delightful alfresco experience. This floor’s only guest bedroom features a king bed, TV, and front balcony access with pool views. A laundry room adds convenience.The top floor offers a serene escape with a spacious primary bedroom, boasting a king bed, TV, private bathroom with a tub, and balcony access with stunning Gulf views. Additional accommodations include 2 guest bedrooms with king beds, TVs, and a shared Jack-and-Jill bathroom, plus a kid-friendly bunk room with 1 twin-over-twin bunk, 2 twin beds, and a TV.Experience Villa Sienna’s charm, only minutes from beautiful Deer Lake State Park! With on-site parking for 6 vehicles—plus a 6-passenger low speed vehicle and 6 adult bikes—exploring is easy. For beach access, take the private boardwalk or enjoy the 4-minute stroll to Walton Dunes Beach. Book now!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 22):FIRST FLOOR: - Guest Bedroom: One Twin-over-King Bunk Bed and Two Twin-over-Queen Bunk Beds, Private Bathroom with Shower SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower THIRD FLOOR: - Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Bunk Room: One Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed and Two Twin Beds, Shared Hall Bath with Shower/ Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower - Guest Bedroom: King Bed and Twin Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower
